events.title: Minor Update v0.11.11: New SEMI-AUTO Mode & Better Screen Fit
events.summary: Hello Pilgrims! Here's what's new since v0.11.9. New Battle Mode: SEMI-AUTO SEMI-AUTO is now the default. Units on the field attack on their own, while you play cards, attack with your hero, use skills and end your turn. Switch between Manual, SEMI and AUTO with the button. Your choice is saved. Your first battle now starts in your saved mode instead of forced AUTO. Screen & UI No more black bars on the sides at any resolution or window ratio. The CRT screen edge now always curves only slightly.

events.summary: Hello Pilgrims! A small follow-up to v0.11.3. Battle Screen New number badges: you can see your opponent's hand, deck and graveyard, and your own deck and graveyard. A full hand shows as "7/7". Click your deck or a graveyard to see the list of cards in it. Mana crystals show your current and maximum mana. events.title: Minor Update v0.9.0: Sharper Battles, Smaller Download
events.summary: Hello Pilgrims! A small update is now live with visual polish and a much lighter download. Visuals Battlers, card art, card frames and the battlefield (floor, walls, cliffs) now render with smoothing, so edges no longer shimmer when units are drawn small. New art for the hero skill Fire Breath. AI opponents now use the new hero portraits. The turn history (top right) now fits each card's art to its thumbnail instead of cropping it. events.title: Now Available on Linux
events.summary: Linux Build Added Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel now runs natively on Linux (64-bit x86). On Linux, Steam installs the Linux version automatically, so you no longer need Proton. The demo and the playtest have the Linux version too. Nothing changes for Windows players. Tell Us How It Runs This is our first Linux build. If something doesn't work, please post in the Steam discussions with your distro and graphics card.

events.title: Minor Update: Half the Download Size
events.summary: Smaller Download The game is now about 720 MB, down from about 1.6 GB. Battle character and card art textures are now compressed properly, with no visible change in quality. Removed duplicate copies of card and character data that were included twice. No Extra Download on First Launch All card and character data now comes with the Steam download, so the game no longer downloads data after you start it. events.title: The Battlefield Comes Alive — 2.5D Sideview Combat Update
events.summary: The arena will never look the same. This update rebuilds Astralight's battles from the ground up — the flat card board is gone, replaced by a living 2.5D battlefield where every unit stands, breathes, and fights.Living 2.5D BattlersCards you play no longer lie on the board — they step onto it. Every character now appears as an animated battler with idle, attack, and defense motions, dynamic shadows, and proper depth: units in front stand in front, no matter their size.
